# Eject widens the opt-in: the fork enables extended CONNECT per server
# while stock Go offers only the process-global GODEBUG=http2xconnect=1.
# The rewritten call delegates to the ejected support module, which
# requires that setting in the process startup environment and panics
# naming the server otherwise, so ejected servers fail fast instead of
# serving without it.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^h2 extended connect ready$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! grep 'EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect' out/main.go
grep 'RequireExtendedConnect' out/main.go
grep 'http2xconnect=1' out/_logos_deps/rt/net/http/h2extendedconnect_ejected.go
cd out
go build ./...
env GODEBUG=http2xconnect=1
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
env GODEBUG=
! exec go run .
stderr 'needs GODEBUG=http2xconnect=1'
stderr 'on server "srv"'
env GODEBUG=http2xconnect=1
exec go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..
cd ..
